title: Ripped as I was putting it on!
text: Ripped as I was putting it on!. This cover ripped all the way down the side as I was putting it on the mattress.  I wish I would have spent more for better quality, but I guess you get what you pay for.

product_metadata.title: DMI Waterproof Mattress Protector, Mattress Pad, Waterproof Mattress Cover, Bed Pad and Bed Cover, Contoured Fitted Sheet, Queen (Packaging May Vary)
features: MATTRESS PROTECTOR AND MATTRESS PAD FOR BEDWETTING protects the mattress and extends its life with a waterproof pad that easily slides on the mattress like a fitted sheet. The deep pockets stop it from moving and sliding when in use
WATERPROOF MATTRESS COVER is perfect for protecting against pet dander, incontinence, accidental spills and for potty training
MATTRESS PAD keeps foreign substances away
WATERPROOF BED PAD IS CONSTRUCTED OF DURABLE AND DEPENDABLE MATERIAL that is quiet and will not crack, peel or discolor over time
description: This durable and dependable best-selling mattress protector and cover helps not only protect your mattress but extend the life of it. It’s very easy to clean. This mattress protector helps protect against foreign substances. It will not make noise or move around when in place. The plastic does not crack, peel, discolor or harden overt time.
